reply_format: ID | STATUS | value/link/file   (STATUS: DONE | PROVIDED | N/A)

items.text: Has the assessment fee been paid? Share the payment confirmation.
items.why: Payment gates the start.

items.text: Have you accepted the assessment terms?
items.why: Terms must be on record before work starts.

items.text: Send the Google Ads account IDs (CIDs) for every brand, or your MCC ID, and accept the association request.
items.why: Lets us read spend, ROAS and campaigns directly so you do not have to export them.
items.task_if_answered: Verify Google Ads access and pull account structure

items.text: Invite our address to every Google Merchant Center account. Which accounts exist?
items.why: Feed and product status drive Shopping profit.
items.task_if_answered: Audit Merchant Center feed and product status

items.text: Invite our address to every GA4 property. Which properties exist?
items.why: Conversion and traffic data come from GA4.
items.task_if_answered: Verify GA4 access and check conversion setup

items.text: Grant read-only store access (e.g. Shopify collaborator), or confirm you will export sales, cancellations and returns instead.
items.why: Sales and returns are the base for profit analysis.
items.task_if_answered: Connect store data and check completeness

items.text: Share product cost (COGS) per product, or per category if per product is not available.
items.why: Margin-based bidding needs real unit cost.
items.task_if_answered: Build margin by product

items.text: Share gross or contribution margin (%) by category.
items.why: Shows which categories actually make money.
items.task_if_answered: Rank categories by margin

items.text: What is the break-even ROAS by category, the level below which a sale loses money?
items.why: This is the line between profit and waste in ad spend.
items.task_if_answered: Compare ROAS targets to break-even
items.task_if_gap: Compute break-even ROAS from margin and costs

items.text: Share average costs per order: shipping (domestic and international), cost of a return, payment fees.
items.why: Hidden order costs erode margin.
items.task_if_answered: Add order costs to the profit model

items.text: Which products or categories must not be pushed, and what is the minimum acceptable margin?
items.why: Avoids scaling products that lose money or hurt the brand.
items.task_if_answered: Add exclusions to campaign structure

items.text: In your own words, what does success look like for this year and next, and what would make this assessment worth it?
items.why: We aim the whole assessment at your definition of success.
items.task_if_answered: Write objectives into the BRD

items.text: What are your revenue and margin targets for this year and next?
items.why: Targets set how aggressive spend can be.
items.task_if_answered: Set profit targets in the BRD

items.text: What is your current monthly revenue (state whether it includes VAT)?
items.why: Baseline for measuring gains.
items.task_if_answered: Record baseline

items.text: List key dates: seasonal peaks, sales events, launches, trade shows.
items.why: Timing decides when to scale and when to prepare stock.
items.task_if_answered: Build calendar of key dates

items.text: How do you define net profit (what is deducted), and which source is the source of truth (store, accounting, other)?
items.why: Gains are measured against this definition.
items.task_if_answered: Fix profit definition and reference period

items.text: How does data flow between your store, feed tools, ad platforms, email and marketplaces? Use: source -> destination -> data -> frequency.
items.why: Wrong data flows cause wrong prices, stock and conversions in ads.
items.task_if_answered: Document data-flow map and flag risks

items.text: How does the product feed reach Merchant Center (store app, third-party feed tool, agency)?
items.why: Feed quality controls Shopping visibility and profit.
items.task_if_answered: Review feed setup

items.text: Which tool is the source of truth for price, stock and product cost?
items.why: Conflicting sources cause errors in margin and availability.
items.task_if_answered: Check source-of-truth consistency

items.text: What does the conversion value contain (revenue with VAT, without VAT, or margin), and are cancellations and returns deducted afterwards?
items.why: Smart bidding optimizes toward this number, so it must reflect profit.
items.task_if_answered: Validate conversion value against profit

items.text: Is product cost (COGS) filled in for all products in your store? List the custom labels used in the feed.
items.why: Missing cost blocks margin-based bidding.
items.task_if_answered: Check COGS completeness and custom labels
items.task_if_gap: Fill COGS gaps in the store

items.text: Export sales by date, SKU and quantity, with selling price and discounts, channels separated.
items.why: Core dataset for profit by product.
items.task_if_answered: Load sales dataset and check quality

items.text: Export cancellations and returns, by SKU and date.
items.why: Returns turn apparent profit into losses.
items.task_if_answered: Net returns from sales

items.text: Export stock by SKU, plus stock-outs and their dates.
items.why: Ads on out-of-stock products waste money.
items.task_if_answered: Cross stock-outs with ad spend

items.text: Export ad spend, impressions, clicks and conversions by channel (Google, Meta, other).
items.why: Needed to compare spend with real profit.
items.task_if_answered: Join ad spend to margin

items.text: Flag any data that is unavailable, incomplete or covers a shorter period.
items.why: We need to know what the numbers can and cannot support.
items.task_if_answered: Record data limits in the BRD

items.text: Who are your main competitors (pure players, marketplaces, others)?
items.why: Shapes positioning, pricing and auction analysis.
items.task_if_answered: Add competitor set to the BRD

items.text: Describe your target customers (personas) and the products or niches you want to grow first.
items.why: Tells us where to point profitable spend.
items.task_if_answered: Add personas and priorities to the BRD

items.text: What are your return rate by category and your repurchase rate or customer value over 12 months?
items.why: Customer value changes how much we can pay to acquire a sale.
items.task_if_answered: Add LTV and return rate to the profit model

items.text: Which other marketing channels do you use (Meta, email, SEO, marketplaces, affiliates) and what share of the budget does each get?
items.why: Shows where budget could move to earn more profit.
items.task_if_answered: Map budget split by channel

items.text: How often do best-sellers go out of stock and for how long?
items.why: Stock-outs make ad spend wasteful and lose sales.
items.task_if_answered: Quantify lost sales from stock-outs

items.text: How fast can you restock if a product takes off, and what are supplier lead times for your main ranges?
items.why: Decides how hard we can push winners.
items.task_if_answered: Set scaling limits by lead time
